$comment: THE RECORD SET (agent/plans/PLAN-prepush-full-cpu.md part 5). A commit confined to these globs ADVANCES a pre-push receipt instead of voiding it:
npm run ci:quick re-runs only the readers of the touched globs and appends an advances step, and block_unverified_push admits the pushed tree
only through a chain of such steps, recomputing each diff itself. A path outside every glob still voids the receipt.
readers are DERIVED by check:ci-record-paths from every gate's leaves and their imports (cite, root, glob and config tiers, read from code with comments and docstrings blanked), and it reds when this
list differs from the derivation. The derivation over-counts on purpose: a false reader costs one gate at an advance, a missed one lets an
unjudged record change through. A flagged gate that reads nothing goes in notReaders with its reason, by name, and the gate prints it every run.
Globs use only ** and *: the gate, the guard and run.ts globToRegExp read those three alike and differ on ? and braces.

THE PLAN RECORDS (operator ruling 2026-11-16): a commit that only writes plans advances too. agent/plans/**/*.md (QUEUE.md included), agent/INDEX.md, .ci/config/plan-boxes.json and the three plan ledgers (plan-investigation, plan-box-progress, live-proof) are records; their 36 readers are pinned by name in .ci/rediacc_ci/tests/gates/test_gate_record_paths.py (PLAN_READERS).

The plan glob ends in *.md on purpose: a non-.md file under agent/plans/ (an inventory .tsv, a .patch attachment) is judged by check:ci-language-policy, which scans every tracked path, so it voids the receipt. agent/STATE.md is not a record.

`"review": "keep"` on a record keeps its paths in the per-commit review (.claude/hooks/stop/wl_review.py skip_globs): a plan's text is reviewed although it advances the receipt. A record without the key leaves the reviewed diff when its glob is admissible there.

check:ci-pytest is no reader of any record and is not listed: its real-tree tests re-run reader gates, CI runs it on every push, and it costs about 1750 s. The derivation does not flag it, so it needs no notReaders entry; if a later leaf makes it flagged, exempt it by name with this reason instead of declaring it.

A RED receipt advances when none of its failed gates reads a touched record (scripts/ci-runner/run.ts planAdvance): `failed` keeps describing the receipt's own tree, and the push guard still refuses a red no carry covers.
agent/worklist/epics.jsonl stays out: check:ci-pr-task-trailers reads it, and its verdict is a commit-range judgement.

carried-reds.json is a record ONLY for a shrinking commit: block_unverified_push admits a step touching it when the step touches nothing else, both blobs parse, every carry at the new tree is carried at the old one (a set of keys may only lose keys), and no removed excuse covers a finding still red in the receipt. An added or widened entry voids the receipt, whatever this record says.
